    link_count = 0

        component = components[i]

        if component == '' or component == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Handle '..'
        if component == '..':
            if current != '/':
                # Move to parent directory
                current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                if current == '':
                    current = '/'
            i += 1
            continue

        if current == '/':
            candidate = '/' + component

            link_count += 1

                return None

            remaining = components[i+1:]

            if not target.startswith('/'):
                # The link is in candidate, so its directory is the parent of candidate
                link_dir = candidate.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                if link_dir == '':
                    link_dir = '/'

                if link_dir == '/':
                    target = '/' + target
                else:

            target_components = target.split('/')

            if target_components and target_components[0] == '':
                target_components = target_components[1:]
                current = '/'

                current = '/'
            
            # Process target components
            components = target_components + remaining
            i = 0
            continue
        
        # No symlink, move to next component
        current = candidate
        i += 1
    
    # Remove trailing slash (except for '/')
    if current != '/' and current.endswith('/'):
        current = current.rstrip('/')
